# Vendored third-party code

## phaser.min.js

- **Phaser** 3.80.1 — <https://phaser.io> — MIT License, © Phaser Studio Inc.
- Vendored rather than loaded from a CDN so the game opens on a network that blocks
  third-party script hosts, and so a CDN outage cannot take the prototype down.
- Do not edit this file. To upgrade, replace it wholesale and re-run
  `node tests/test_game_page.js` (it loads the real page through a DOM shim) plus a headless
  screenshot check, because a Phaser major change alters texture and scene APIs.
- Full licence text: <https://github.com/phaserjs/phaser/blob/v3.80.1/license.txt>
